summary: Build an AI agent with FalkorDB at its core across three tracks: connected-data reasoning, agent memory and coordination, and company knowledge.
eligibility: Open to developers worldwide, including students and professionals in India. Free entry; minimum age not published.
title: Graph Hacks: Context for AI Agents

prize.description: Advertised US$20,000 of hardware and merchandise, not cash. One prize per track plus blog-post and top-50 side awards.

notes: Submit a repository, README and demo video; FalkorDB must be central to the project.
